name: Pilot control sheet automation
what_changed:
Adds pilot-control/ YAML trackers + scripts/export-pilot-
control-sheet.mjs. Generates deterministic CSVs at
pilot-control/generated/ checked into the repo plus an
optional Hone_Pilot_Control_Sheet.xlsx generated on demand
via npm run pilot:export. GitHub Actions CI runs npm run
pilot:check.
notes:
Internal process / tooling. No app runtime behavior changes.
Flip `merged` to the actual date once this PR lands.

name: Portal layout cleanup
what_changed:
Retired the "Your info" wrapper. Added top-level Appointments,
Care instructions, Forms and records, Payment method sections.
Email <studio> button moved to header. Care instructions open
by default. "Signed forms" renamed to "Completed forms" with
quiet record styling.

name: Card authorization guidance
what_changed:
Portal renders four explicit card states with a "Card
authorization needed" placeholder that deep-links to the
signing form. Matching practitioner PaymentMethodCard renders
the same four branches. Manual fee blocked reasons updated to
actionable copy.

name: Client profile appointment timeline + email AM/PM
what_changed:
Sessions tab now leads with a five-bucket appointment
timeline. Plus a patch fixed the reported email AM/PM bug by
routing every client-facing email through localTimeString12h.
notes: Practitioner calendar / dashboard still 24h. SMS unchanged.

name: Sessions to appointments link
what_changed:
Added sessions.appointment_id FK (migration 0068) with
studio + client + practitioner lineage validation in
startSessionAction. Calendar appointment detail exposes
Chart session. Client-scoped flow still works with null
appointment_id.
notes:
Migration 0068 applied to prod first. No historical
backfill.

name: Pilot readiness hardening
what_changed:
Closed a residual public reschedule raw-error leak,
added server-only boundary on the Supabase admin
client, threaded studio_id into SMS ops alerts, and
refreshed stale docs.
notes: No payment / SMS send / email behavior change.

name: GitHub Actions CI
what_changed:
Added .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs typecheck, lint,
build, npm test, git diff --check, and a Stripe safety
grep gate on every PR and push to default.
notes:
Dummy env values in CI. No real secrets, no deploy
commands.

name: Ops alerts (silent-failure tracking)
what_changed:
Migration 0067 adds an ops_alerts table with redaction +
never-throws contract. SMS / Stripe webhook / manual-fee
paths now log failures durably for operator review.
notes: Operator email loop deferred (no active loop today).

name: Portal Replace card one-click
what_changed:
Replace card now opens the secure form immediately
instead of requiring a second tap. autoStart prop with
useRef guard.

name: Portal Replace card surface
what_changed:
Added the Replace card affordance on the portal active-
card surface. Webhook pre-flips the prior active row to
removed atomically when the new SetupIntent succeeds.
notes:
PR #151 webhook flow has the load-bearing partial-unique
backstop from migration 0058.
